Lina (Finance): Quick question — we have a few prepaid Dedicated invoices where customers changed commitments mid-cycle (AcmeGames INV-2026-0443, BrightByte INV-2026-0472). How should we treat the partial-period for 03/31 close?

Ethan (Billing): We normally prorate the prepaid and move the unused portion to deferred revenue. For AcmeGames they reduced GPUs 8->4 on 2026-03-10; invoice covered 03/01-03/30. A credit memo was issued 03/11. Do you want the JE format?

Lina (Finance): Yes — need a concrete calculation and GL mapping so we can include the manual adjustments in the close pack.

Marta (Revenue Ops): Rule of thumb: earned = (days used / total days) * prepaid. Unearned = prepaid - earned. If a credit memo reduces the prepaid, adjust deferred revenue to reflect the net prepaid balance before recognizing earned.

Jin (Accounting): GLs: Cash/AR (1010), Deferred/Unearned (2205), Revenue - Dedicated (4002), Customer Credits/CM (2108). Example JE to record recognition through 03/31 (simplified):
```
Dr Unearned Revenue (2205) — $10,666
Cr Revenue - Dedicated (4002) — $10,666
```
If the credit memo reduced prepaid earlier, reduce Unearned Revenue first using the CM reference.

Ethan (Billing): I'll provide a CSV dump of affected prepaid invoices with start/end dates, credited amounts and CM refs (INV id, CM id, original amount, days used, days remaining). Will post to #finance-uploads by 12:30pm.

Lina (Finance): Thanks. Jin — do we want a brief memo in the close pack for auditors describing the adjustment methodology?

Jin (Accounting): Yes. Include: reason for manual adjustment, sample calculation for one invoice, impacted GL accounts, and CM numbers. That creates a clear audit trail.

RevenueBot: Notification: invoice INV-2026-0443 credited (CM-9931) by Billing at 2026-03-11T09:12:03Z.

Marta (Revenue Ops): I'll update the revenue schedule generator to flag mid-term changes and emit a prorated schedule. ETA: small change by EOD. Also recommend we decide a policy for pricing-experiment customers (auto prorate vs. manual refund) before Q2 close.

Ethan (Billing): Noted — I'll draft a short policy proposal and link to the pricing-experiments thread.

Lina (Finance): Great — once CSV is uploaded I'll run the calculations and post the JE lines for review. :thumbsup:

Ethan (Billing): CSV uploaded to #finance-uploads: 1772520000-prepay-midterm-extract.csv

Lina (Finance): Received. I'll prepare the memo and JEs and attach to the close pack. Closing loop — thanks all. :white_check_mark:
